entities.summary: Elias Veikko Juhani Valtonen is a Finnish professional basketball player for Covirán Granada of the Liga ACB, and for the Finland national team. He played college basketball for the Arizona State Sun Devils. Valtonen is 2.01 m tall, and plays the shooting guard position.
